description: Attach a screenshot to an item. Attach a screenshot, screen recording, or file to a bug or feature request, so the fixer sees what QA saw instead of reconstructing it from measurements. Send the bytes as `contentBase64` (a bare base64 string or a `data:` URI) or give a public https `url` for the server to fe…

contentBase64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (a bare string or a `data:<mime>;base64,` URI). Pass this or `url`, not both.

filename.description: File name, e.g. `checkout-overflow.png`. Defaults to the last segment of `url`, else `file`.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

kind.description: Attachment kind. Defaults from the media type (image → screenshot, video → recording, else file). Ignored by the comment-media upload.

mimeType.description: Media type, e.g. `image/png`. Defaults from the data URI, the fetched response, or the filename extension.

url.description: A public https URL for the server to fetch the file from (no IP literals or internal hosts; max 25 MiB). Pass this or `contentBase64`, not both.

name: ops_attachments_create
